Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.431), which favours a weighted combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single catboost' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.3632. Series context: trend strength 0.9552 and seasonal strength 0.065; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.431); 9 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 20.001.
